capabilities: Set opening mode per folder, property, or file age rule
Block switching to Editing with a Read-only toggle on rules
Cycle global modes (Auto, Locked, Editing) from the status bar or commands
Preserve manual mode choices when switching tabs
Translate settings and commands via locale JSON files
disambiguation: It does not make files read-only on disk; it only controls the Obsidian view mode and can block switching to Editing inside the app.
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, requires Obsidian 1.4.10+, and includes English and Korean translations.
motivation: Keep reference notes ready to read and working drafts ready to edit without switching modes every time a note is opened.
problem: Obsidian opens every note in the same mode by default, so users must manually toggle between Reading and Editing when moving between reference notes and drafts.
summary: Rule-based view-mode manager that opens notes in Reading or Editing mode based on folder, frontmatter property, or file age.
